renderDetails.messageTitle: Install OpenJDK and Maven via Choco: Command may require input

content:
The command output has stabilized for 5s. The output delta since last check is:
Chocolatey v2.7.1

 (cmd/powershell).

 You may experience errors - many functions/packages
 require admin rights. Only advanced users should run choco w/out an
 elevated shell. When you open the command shell, you should ensure
 that you do so with "Run as Administrator" selected. If you are
 attempting to use Chocolatey in a non-administrator setting, you
 must select a different location other than the default install
 location. See
 https://docs.chocolatey.org/en-us/choco/setup#non-administrative-install
 for details.

For the question below, you have 20 seconds to make a selection.

 Do you want to continue?([Y]es/[N]o): 

The command appears to be waiting for input: The command is asking the user to confirm whether they want to proceed with the installation.
